card.name: Capital J starts and mg after doses
card.fires_on: Responds to a capital J that starts a name or title such as Jerusalem or JewishGen, and to mg right after a dose number. It also fires on the middle of Prolonged.

modes.label: Capital J word start
modes.description: A lone J at the start of a proper name or title, such as Jerusalem or Jewish.

modes.label: mg after a number
modes.description: The unit mg directly after a dose figure in dosing or interaction text.

modes.label: Inside Prolonged
modes.description: The rol piece inside the word Prolonged or Prolonging.
